      Amazon Customer
      5 out of 5 stars
      Best redmi phone ever
      This is actually a really good phone, please ignore the negative reviews. People who are complaining about not fast charging, go to battery setting and select speed up option. It takes about 2 hours to go from 0 to 100 on standard charging mode and about 1 hour 15 mins or so to go from 0 to 100 on speed up charge mode. I did not see any lagging at all, phone's performance is very smooth and so fast, apps install and uninstall very quickly. people who are heavy game users may add virtual RAM in memory extension option, I added 6GB more so now I have 12GB on 6GB RAM variant. Network performance is also awesome, it supports B28 band so BSNL 4G internet works amazing on this phone, I am getting 42-50 Mbps 4G speed even inside home. This is the main reason why I bought it and also because of huge battery. Phone camera is ok, there's many filters that can be used to enhance image's colors to match it's original color. Camera zoom is 10x not sure why someone said zoom is not supported. It has amazing AI filters and features for pics including erase. And by the way, use Gemini to upload your pic and ask it to enhance it etc and you'll be surprised with the results. Attached is an example, original picture is clicked from very far away with 10x zoom and the other is the amazing result from gemini after I uploaded it and asked it to enhance the pic quality and make it crispy clear, it's amazing how it can do that, everything became perfect with it's enhancement, so try gemini for your landscape/natural scenery pictures, it makes them so better. Speaker is perfect too, 200% volume boost is perfect. Also you can choose dolby or xiaomi in settings and choose various audio equalizer settings to enjoy different modes per your song genres. And phone's aesthetic value is also appealing, it looks amazing. screen is very large and you can get matte screen guard to make screen look even more pleasing than the standard glass screen protectors. Phone is little bit heavy but that's obviously because of it's huge size.

        Network performance is also awesome, it supports B28 band so BSNL 4G internet works amazing on this phone, I am getting 42-50 Mbps 4G speed even inside home. This is the main reason why I bought it and also because of huge battery.

        Speaker is perfect too, 200% volume boost is perfect. Also you can choose dolby or xiaomi in settings and choose various audio equalizer settings to enjoy different modes per your song genres.

        And phone's aesthetic value is also appealing, it looks amazing. screen is very large and you can get matte screen guard to make screen look even more pleasing than the standard glass screen protectors. Phone is little bit heavy but that's obviously because of it's huge size.
